rows.concrete_observation: Native addDefaultEntries registers Mob→HackableMobDisarm; class+alive+any nonempty EquipmentSlot qualify, with no Boss predicate in this game producer. Native key handler→entity targets→hack() requires client initialized and looking; sends entityID C2S. Start server checks entity-tracker upgrade usable and current-world ID exists, saves entity/resetTime then confirms; it does not itself repeat client look condition. Actual HackHandler server tick→tickServerSide→tickEntityHack resolves hackable, requires positive time, increments and on>=60 plus alive calls native _onHackFinished; completion action then tracker registration and finish broadcast, no action-result bool. HackableMobDisarm server enumerates slots; first nonempty doDisarm returns true and terminates loop. Drop chance uses raw Mob hand/armor drop array; >1 means no damage, otherwise probability controls spawn and possibly damage clamp. Regardless of drop roll or spawn return, it clears slot to EMPTY and true. Thus one real equipment removal attempt, not guaranteed one spawned pickup. Manager cache checks canHack on lookup creation and periodic prune (>60 time gap), not on every cached return. Disarm rechecks slot presence but no HP/potion gate. Finish packet only entityID; client resolves entity/current hackable, invokes client no-op finish, registers tracker, clears local hacking and plays finish sound only if those lookups succeeded. Native HUD addInfo uses local hackTime/tracked and _getHackTime to choose progress/finished text; no final slot/result data is sent.
rows.application_to_boss_immune: Treat equipment loss as direct control requiring a final producer-specific refusal before stack mutation. Drop absence or unchanged HP cannot identify immunity. A generic completion packet and finished HUD are operation receipts, not proof an equipment stack dropped or the intended slot remains removed. Revalidate native target/source/effect before committing or emitting an authoritative immune reason; do not copy this broad destructive action into Boss feedback.
